rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the railway as a transport system; use 路軌 when you mean the physical tracks.

example.english: Taking the railroad to Guangzhou is much more convenient.
example.traditional: 我哋搭鐵路去廣州方便好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 tit3 lou6 heoi3 gwong2 zau1 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the physical rails and trackbed, rather than the railway service or system.

example.english: The workers are inspecting the railroad.
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 ji4 gaa1 gim2 caa4 gan2 lou6 gwai2
